note: First-floor gym of the first prepositions (cartoon style): lime-green walls, blue gym mat, wooden climbing frame (landmark) and a big wall clock. Back row: derrière (boy by the tall milk churn), entre (girl stepping between two curtains), contre (arm-wrestling), sauf (the one man lounging in an armchair). Front row: de (girl with a slice of cake), pour (pouring water for the dog), avec (man with his vacuum), sans (barefoot, no shoes). Prepositions have no gender (divider null). The big wall clock zooms in on the time prepositions. The cherry-red door on the left goes back to the pronouns parlour; the sky-blue door on the right goes on to the second prepositions room.
